verdict.rationale: Close is a CRM that ships built-in AI (the Chloe agent) and an MCP server, so a training opt-out is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence pack covers a setting, policy, or contractual commitment that keeps customer data out of AI model training. The cited items cover APIs, webhooks, MCP scopes, pricing and Chloe's features, none of which address training-data use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
